series.name: Mahanagarpalika 101
series.tagline: Tumhara paisa. Tumhara shaher. Tumhara sawaal.
series.concept: A retired civics teacher in Ichalkaranji gets a 3x property tax bill after the city upgrades from Nagar Parishad to Municipal Corporation. He starts asking questions — filing RTIs, meeting his corporator, attending ward meetings — and discovers that most citizens don't know what they're paying for or what they can demand. Each episode covers one aspect of how a municipal corporation works, delivered through his journey.

episodes.title: Teen Guna Tax

slides.text:
Govind Deshpande ne 35 saal Ichalkaranji ke bacchon ko nagarshaastra padhaya.

Constitution. Panchayati Raj. Municipal governance.

Phir retire hua.

Aur phir ek din — uska property tax ka bill aaya.

₹3,800 tha pehle.

Ab ₹11,400.

Teen guna.

Govind ne bill palat ke dekha. Upar likha tha:

"Ichalkaranji Mahanagarpalika."

Nagar Parishad thi. Ab Mahanagarpalika hai.

Par ghar toh wahi hai. Sadak toh wahi hai. Nali toh wahi band hai.

Sunanda ne kaha — "Bharo. Sab bhar rahe hain."

Govind ne kaha — "35 saal bacchon ko padhaya ki nagrik ka haq hai sawaal karna."

"Aaj khud se poochhunga — mera paisa ja kahan raha hai?"

Nagar Parishad vs Mahanagarpalika.

Nagar Parishad: Chhota budget. Limited staff. Basic services.

Mahanagarpalika: Bada budget. 40 departments. 1,744 posts sanctioned. Property tax, water tax, drainage cess — sab badh gaya.

Par services? "Woh bhi badhenge" — yeh promise hai.

Ichalkaranji ka population: 3.5 lakh.

65 wards.

Agar har ghar average ₹10,000 tax deta hai — shaher se ₹80-100 crore sirf property tax se.

Plus state grants. Plus central schemes.

Total budget: kahin ₹500-800 crore ke beech.

Sawaal yeh hai — yeh paisa dikhega kahan?

Tumhara tax badhne ka matlab yeh hai ki tumhare rights bhi badh gaye.

Mahanagarpalika ke 18 mandatory functions:
1. Water supply
2. Drainage & sewage
3. Solid waste management
4. Roads & bridges
5. Street lighting
6. Public health
7. Birth & death registration
8. Building permissions

...and 10 more.

Yeh "optional" nahi hai. Yeh KANUNI ZIMMEDAARI hai.

Govind ne ek register nikala.

Pehle page pe likha:

"Mera ward: 23. Mera nagar sevak: kaun? Meri sadak ka kya haal hai? Pichle saal kitna paisa mere ward pe kharch hua?"

"Yeh sawaal main poochhunga. RTI se. Ward committee mein. Jo bhi rasta hoga."

"Kyunki agar main — jo 35 saal civics padhata raha — yeh nahi jaanta... toh kaun jaanta hai?"

Teen guna tax.

Par kya teen guna service milegi?

Yeh sawaal sirf Govind ka nahi hai.

Yeh sawaal har Ichalkaranji wale ka hai.

Agle episode mein: Govind poochhega — "Mera paisa jaata kahan hai?" — aur answer dhundne ke liye pehli RTI file karega.

episodes.synopsis: Govind gets his property tax bill — 3x what he used to pay. He taught civics for 35 years but never questioned his own city's governance. Today he starts.
episodes.caption: Tumhara property tax teen guna ho gaya. Kya tumhe pata hai ki us paise se tumhe kya milna chahiye? Agle episode mein Govind RTI file karega. Follow @go.one.level.deeper.

episodes.title: Pehli RTI

slides.text:
Govind ne zindagi mein kabhi RTI nahi file kiya tha.

35 saal civics padhaya — RTI ka chapter bhi.

Par kabhi form nahi bhara.

Aaj pehli baar bharega.

Tanvi — padosan ki beti, journalism student — ne kaha:

"Deshpande kaka, RTI online hota hai ab. rtionline.gov.in."

Govind: "Mujhe kya poochhna chahiye?"

Tanvi: "Simple. Ward 23 ka last year ka kharcha. Kitna aaya, kahan gaya."

RTI mein kya likhna hai:

1. Kisko: Public Information Officer, Ichalkaranji Mahanagarpalika
2. Kya chahiye: Ward 23 ka varshik kharcha vivaran, 2025-26
3. Fees: ₹10 (online payment)
4. Reply deadline: 30 din

Bas. Itna hi. Koi vakeel nahi chahiye. Koi approach nahi chahiye.

RTI Act, 2005 — Section 3:

"Sabhi nagrikon ko suchna ka adhikaar hai."

Mahanagarpalika SARKARI SANSTHAN hai. Tumhara paisa chalata hai ise. Toh tumhe PATA HONA CHAHIYE ki paisa kahan ja raha hai.

Yeh ehsaan nahi hai. Yeh KANOON hai.

Govind ne RTI file kiya.

21 din baad — reply aaya.

8 page ka PDF.

Ward 23 ka budget: ₹4.2 crore.

Kharcha: Roads — ₹1.8 crore. Drainage — ₹85 lakh. Street lights — ₹32 lakh. "Miscellaneous" — ₹1.1 crore.

Sunanda: "Miscellaneous mein 1 crore? Yeh kya hai?"

₹1.1 crore "Miscellaneous."

Koi detail nahi. Koi breakdown nahi.

Govind ne doosri RTI file ki:

"Miscellaneous ₹1.1 crore ka item-wise breakdown dijiye."

Yeh uska haq hai. Aur mahanagarpalika ko 30 din mein jawab dena HOGA.

RTI kaise file karein — step by step:

1. rtionline.gov.in pe jao
2. "Submit Request" pe click karo
3. Public Authority: "Ichalkaranji Mahanagarpalika" chuno
4. Apna sawaal likho — specific rakho
5. ₹10 online pay karo
6. Acknowledgment number save karo
7. 30 din wait karo
8. Reply na aaye toh — First Appeal file karo (free hai)

Pehli RTI file karna Govind ke liye sabse mushkil tha.

Doosri aasan thi.

Teesri aadat ban gayi.

Tumhari pehli RTI ka sawaal kya hoga?

Agle episode mein: Govind ko "Miscellaneous" ka jawab milta hai. Aur usse pata chalta hai ki uska nagar sevak kaun hai — aur woh karta kya hai.

episodes.synopsis: Govind files his first RTI with help from Tanvi. He asks for Ward 23's budget breakdown. The reply reveals a suspicious ₹1.1 crore under 'Miscellaneous.'
episodes.caption: Kya tumne kabhi RTI file kiya hai? ₹10 mein tumhe apne ward ka poora budget pata chal sakta hai. Try karo — rtionline.gov.in. Batao comments mein — tumhara pehla sawaal kya hoga?

episodes.title: Nagar Sevak Kaun?

slides.text:
Govind ko miscellaneous ka breakdown mila.

Usme ek line thi:

"Ward development fund — Nagar Sevak discretionary — ₹42 lakh."

Govind ne socha — mera nagar sevak kaun hai?

35 saal Ichalkaranji mein raha. Pata nahi.

Govind ne Google kiya: "Ichalkaranji Ward 23 nagar sevak"

Kuch nahi mila.

Tanvi ne mahanagarpalika ki website kholi. Ward list mila.

Ward 23: Ashok Kale. BJP.

Phone number? Nahi hai.

Office address? Ward office, Shahupuri.

"Chalo milte hain," Govind ne kaha.

Ward office. Ek kamra. Ek table. Teen kursiyan.

Ashok Kale wahan nahi tha.

Ek clerk ne kaha: "Sahab Friday ko aate hain. 11 se 1."

Govind: "Unka kaam kya hai exactly?"

Clerk: "..."

Nagar Sevak (Corporator) — kya karna chahiye:

1. Ward ki samasyaein mahanagarpalika mein uthana
2. Ward development fund ka sahi istemaal
3. Ward committee meetings mein participate karna
4. Nagrikon ki complaints forward karna
5. Budget proposals mein ward ka paksh rakhna
6. General Body meetings mein vote karna

Yeh ZIMMEDAARI hai — ehsaan nahi.

Govind Friday ko gaya.

Ashok Kale mile. Chai mili.

Govind: "Ward 23 mein pichle saal ₹42 lakh discretionary fund se kya hua?"

Kale: "Sadak bani Laxmi Nagar mein. Drainage ka kaam hua Ganesh Colony mein."

Govind: "Yeh kaam ka record public hai?"

Kale: "Haan... hona chahiye."

Govind: "Toh mujhe dikhao."

Tumhara nagar sevak tumhara PRATINIDHI hai.

Tum usse MIL sakte ho.
Tum usse SAWAAL poochh sakte ho.
Tum usse JAWAB maang sakte ho.

Woh tumhare tax ke paise se kaam karta hai.

Agar tumhe nahi pata tumhara nagar sevak kaun hai — toh woh bina jawabdehri ke kaam kar raha hai.

Apna nagar sevak kaise dhundein:

1. Mahanagarpalika website pe ward list dekho
2. Apne ward ka number pata karo (voter ID pe hota hai)
3. Nagar sevak ka naam, party, contact dhundho
4. Ward office jao — weekly meeting ka din poochho
5. Ek sawaal lekar jao: "Mere ward mein pichle saal kya kaam hua?"

Bas ek baar jao. Ek baar sawaal poochho. Dekhna — asar hota hai.

65 wards. 65 nagar sevak.

Kitne logon ko apna nagar sevak pata hai?

Govind ko nahi pata tha. Ab pata hai.

Tumhe?

Agle episode mein: Govind discover karta hai ki uska paani ka bill bhi badha hai — aur poochhta hai "24x7 water supply ka promise kab poora hoga?"

episodes.synopsis: Govind gets the Miscellaneous breakdown and finds ₹42 lakh in 'Nagar Sevak discretionary fund.' He realizes he doesn't even know who his corporator is. He finds out, visits the ward office, and asks his first direct question.
episodes.caption: Tumhe apne nagar sevak ka naam pata hai? Ward number pata hai? Agar nahi — toh aaj pata karo. Comments mein batao — tumhara ward number kya hai aur tumhara sabse bada sawaal kya hai.

episodes.title: Paani Ka Hisaab

slides.text:
Property tax badha. Water tax bhi badha.

Par paani?

Subah 6 se 8 — agar aaya toh.

Kabhi pressure nahi. Kabhi color nahi.

Govind ne ek aur sawaal register mein likha:

"Mahanagarpalika bani — toh 24x7 paani kab milega?"

Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act — Section 61:

Mahanagarpalika ka KARTAVYA hai — sheher ko paani supply karna.

Yeh optional nahi hai.

Yeh pehli zimmedaari hai.

Corporation bani? Toh adequate water supply dena PADEGA.

Ichalkaranji ki reality:

Paani supply: Subah 6-8 baje. Roz nahi.
Source: Panchganga nadi + bore wells.
Purification: Basic chlorination.
Pipeline: 30+ saal purani. Leakage — estimated 30-40%.

40% paani pipeline mein hi kho jaata hai.

Tum bill poora bharte ho. Paani poora nahi aata.

Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation:

Population: 20 lakh (Ichalkaranji se 6 guna).
24x7 water supply pilot — 3 zones mein successful.
Smart metering. Minimal leakage.

PCMC ne kiya — toh Ichalkaranji kyun nahi kar sakta?

Budget hai. Law hai. Staff hai.

Ichhashakti hai?

Govind ne Ashok Kale ko phone kiya.

"Kale sahab, Ward 23 mein paani ki kya planning hai?"

Kale: "Pipeline replacement ka proposal hai. Budget mein hai."

Govind: "Kab se hai?"

Kale: "... Do saal se."

Govind: "Do saal se proposal hai. Pipeline wahi purani. Tax naya. Paani wahi purana."

Paani ke baare mein tumhare rights:

1. Adequate water supply — mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari (Section 61)
2. Water quality testing results — public hone chahiye
3. Pipeline repair timeline — RTI se maang sakte ho
4. New connection — defined timeline mein milna chahiye
5. Bill dispute — grievance cell mein ja sakte ho

Yeh sab TUMHARA HAQ hai.

Aaj kya kar sakte ho:

1. Apne area ka water supply schedule poochho — ward office se
2. RTI file karo: "Ward __ mein pipeline replacement ka plan kya hai?"
3. Water quality test maango — yeh free hai, mahanagarpalika ka kaam hai
4. Apne nagar sevak se poochho: paani ka budget kitna hai aur kharcha kahan ho raha hai?

Sawaal poochho. Jawab milega.

Paani — zindagi ki pehli zaroorat.

Mahanagarpalika ki pehli zimmedaari.

Tumhara tax teen guna hua.

Tumhara paani?

Agle episode mein: Sadak kiski? Govind poochhta hai — kaun decide karta hai ki kaunsi sadak pehle banti hai?

episodes.synopsis: Govind's water bill has also increased. But the supply is still erratic — 2 hours in the morning, sometimes nothing. He investigates what the mahanagarpalika is supposed to provide vs what Ichalkaranji actually gets.
episodes.caption: Tumhare area mein paani kitne ghante aata hai? Kya quality theek hai? Kya tumhe pata hai ki mahanagarpalika ko adequate water supply dena KANUNI ZIMMEDAARI hai? Comments mein batao — tumhare ward mein paani ka kya haal hai.

episodes.title: Sadak Kiski?

slides.text:
Ward 23 mein ek sadak hai jo har saal banti hai.

Aur ek sadak hai jisme 3 saal se wahi gaddha hai.

Dono sadak same ward mein hain.

Dono ka tax same logon se aata hai.

Phir farak kyun?

Sadak kaise banti hai — 2 raaste:

1. WARD FUND: Nagar sevak decide karta hai. Chhote kaam — gali ki sadak, patch work. ₹40-50 lakh/saal per ward.

2. CITY FUND: Mahanagarpalika decide karti hai. Bade kaam — main road, bridge, naya rasta. Standing committee approve karti hai.

Tumhari gali — ward fund se banni chahiye.
Main road — city fund se.

Toh kaun decide karta hai ki kaunsi gali pehle bane?

Official answer: Priority list based on condition survey.

Real answer: Jo zyada awaaz uthaye. Jo nagar sevak ke kareeb ho. Jo vote bank ho.

Govind ne Kale se poochha: "Ward 23 ki priority list hai?"

Kale: "Haan... par sab ek saath nahi ho sakta."

Govind: "List dikhao. Log khud decide karenge ki kya pehle hona chahiye."

Sadak banne ka process:

1. Proposal banta hai (nagar sevak ya engineer)
2. Estimate banta hai (PWD department)
3. Tender nikalta hai (public notice — newspaper mein)
4. Contractor select hota hai (lowest bid... usually)
5. Kaam hota hai
6. Quality check hota hai (hona chahiye)

Step 3 se 6 tak — sab PUBLIC hai.
Tum dekh sakte ho. Sawaal poochh sakte ho.

Prashant — Govind ka padosi, loom owner — ne bataya:

"Humari gali ki sadak pichle saal bani thi. 6 mahine mein ukhad gayi."

"Contractor wahi tha jo pichli baar bhi tha."

"Quality check? Kisi ne kiya hi nahi."

Yeh sirf ek gali ki kahani hai.

Par pattern har jagah same hai — jab koi sawaal nahi poochhta, quality girr jaati hai.

Tumhare haath mein kya hai:

1. Tender notice dekho — newspaper mein aata hai, website pe bhi
2. Contractor ka naam pata karo
3. Kaam ka estimate vs actual kharcha — RTI se maango
4. Quality check report — RTI se maango
5. Sadak toot gayi 1 saal mein? — Written complaint karo, guarantee period hota hai

Contractor ko GUARANTEE deni padti hai. Agar sadak guarantee period mein toote — FREE mein banana padega.

Govind ne kiya:

1. Ward 23 ki sadak priority list RTI se maangi
2. Pichle 2 saal ke road tender documents maange
3. Quality check reports maangi

"Agar yeh sab public hai — toh public ko dikhana padega."

Kale sahab thode uncomfortable hue.

Par documents dene padenge. Kanoon hai.

Har sadak ka record hota hai.
Har tender public hota hai.
Har contractor ki guarantee hoti hai.

Bas koi poochhta nahi.

Govind ne poochhna shuru kiya.

Tumhari gali mein gaddha hai?
Toh sawaal tumhara hai.

Agle episode mein: Kachra kaun uthayega? Solid waste management — mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari, tumhari bhi.

episodes.synopsis: Govind notices that some roads in Ward 23 are freshly paved while his street has had the same pothole for 3 years. He investigates how road construction decisions are made — ward fund vs city fund, tenders, and why some streets get fixed while others don't.
episodes.caption: Tumhari gali ki sadak kab bani thi? Kitne din mein toot gayi? Kya tumhe pata hai ki contractor ko guarantee deni padti hai? Comments mein batao — tumhare area ki sabse bekaar sadak kaunsi hai.

episodes.title: Kachra Kaun Uthayega?

slides.text:
Govind ke mohalle mein kachra gaadi kabhi aati hai, kabhi nahi.

Koi schedule nahi. Koi segregation nahi.

Corner pe ek dumpster hai — overflow hota rehta hai.

Mahanagarpalika bani. Budget badha. Staff badha.

Kachra wahi hai.

Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016:

Mahanagarpalika ko DOOR-TO-DOOR collection karna ZARURI hai.

Wet waste aur dry waste ALAG collect karna ZARURI hai.

Roz. Har ghar se.

Yeh Swachh Bharat ka part hai — par implement mahanagarpalika ko karna hai.

Ichalkaranji mein kya ho raha hai:

- Door-to-door: Kuch wards mein. Baaki mein nahi.
- Segregation: Koi enforce nahi karta.
- Processing plant: Hai ya nahi? Koi nahi jaanta.
- Landfill: Sheher ke bahar — overloaded.

Saara kachra ek jagah jaata hai. Sorted nahi. Processed nahi. Bas dump.

Tum already pay kar rahe ho.

Property tax mein sanitation cess included hai.

Matlab — kachra uthana tumhare tax se hota hai.

Agar kachra nahi uth raha — toh tumhara paisa kahan ja raha hai?

Govind ne RTI file ki: "Ward 23 mein solid waste management pe pichle saal kitna kharcha hua? Kitne safai karmchari hain? Route schedule kya hai?"

Kya hona chahiye — step by step:

1. Har ghar ko 2 bins milne chahiye (wet/dry) — mahanagarpalika degi
2. Roz subah door-to-door collection
3. Wet waste composting — ward level pe
4. Dry waste recycling center
5. Hazardous waste (batteries, medical) — separate collection

Yeh sab SWM Rules 2016 mein likha hai. Optional nahi hai.

Haan — tumhari bhi zimmedaari hai.

SWM Rules kehte hain:

1. Ghar pe wet/dry waste alag karo
2. Kachra sadak pe mat phenko
3. Construction waste separately dispose karo
4. Fine lagega agar rules nahi maane

Mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari — uthana.
Tumhari zimmedaari — alag karna.

Dono milke kaam karenge toh saaf hoga.

Aaj kya karo:

1. Apne area ka collection schedule poochho — ward office se
2. 2 din kachra nahi utha? Written complaint karo
3. RTI: "Ward __ mein kitne safai karmchari hain?"
4. Mohalle ke logon se baat karo — milke segregation shuru karo

Ek gali saaf hogi — toh doosri bhi seekhegi.

Kachra sirf safai ka sawaal nahi hai.

Yeh health ka sawaal hai. Paani ka sawaal hai. Izzat ka sawaal hai.

Tum tax de rahe ho.

Safai tumhara HAQ hai.

Agle episode mein: Nali Band Hai — monsoon mein Ichalkaranji kyun doobta hai?

episodes.synopsis: Garbage collection in Ichalkaranji is inconsistent. Govind investigates — wet/dry segregation rules, door-to-door collection mandate, and what the corporation is legally required to do.
episodes.caption: Tumhare area mein kachra gaadi roz aati hai? Wet-dry alag hota hai? Kya tumhe pata hai ki door-to-door collection mahanagarpalika ki KANUNI ZIMMEDAARI hai? Batao — tumhare mohalle ka kya haal hai.

episodes.title: Nali Band Hai

slides.text:
Har monsoon mein Ichalkaranji ke kuch mohalle doobte hain.

Wahi mohalle. Har saal.

Paani ghutno tak. Ghar mein ghusta hai.

Koi solution nahi. Bas barish rukne ka intezaar.

Mahanagarpalika bani — ab kya hoga?

Ichalkaranji ka drainage system:

- Zyaadatar OPEN nali — 50+ saal purani
- Underground sewerage: bahut kam areas mein
- Nali mein kachra — clogged permanently
- Storm water drain aur sewage drain — same line
- Panchganga nadi mein untreated sewage jaata hai

Result: Barish hoti hai — paani jaaye toh kahan jaaye?

Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act:

Mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari:
1. Sewage disposal system banana aur maintain karna
2. Storm water drainage system banana
3. Sewage treatment plant chalana
4. Nadi mein untreated sewage jaane se rokna

Yeh MANDATORY duties hain.

Ichalkaranji mein kitna hua? RTI se poochho.

Govind ne RTI se drainage budget maanga.

Pichle 3 saal: ₹12 crore drainage pe allocate.

Kitna kharcha hua? ₹8.5 crore.

₹3.5 crore kahan gaye? "Lapsed. Kaam shuru nahi ho paya."

Matlab — paisa tha. Plan tha. Kaam nahi hua.

Aur mohalle phir doobe.

Kya hona chahiye:

1. Underground sewerage — phased rollout, ward by ward
2. Storm water drains SEPARATE sewage se
3. Sewage Treatment Plant — functional, monitored
4. Nali safai — monsoon se PEHLE, na BAAD mein
5. Encroachment hatao — nali ke upar construction illegal hai

Yeh sab ek saal mein nahi hoga. Par PLAN toh hona chahiye. TIMELINE toh honi chahiye.

Panchganga nadi — Ichalkaranji ki lifeline.

Usme roz hazaaron litre untreated sewage jaata hai.

NGT (National Green Tribunal) ne orders diye hain — treat karo.

Mahanagarpalika ne STP ka plan banaya.

Bana? Chalu hua?

Govind ne RTI file ki.

Monsoon se pehle karo:

1. Apni gali ki nali ka photo lo — bhejo ward office ko
2. RTI: "Ward __ mein monsoon drainage plan kya hai?"
3. Nali pe encroachment hai? — Complaint karo, yeh illegal hai
4. Mohalle ke log milke nali safai demand karo — written mein

Likhit mein maango. Verbal se kuch nahi hota.

₹12 crore allocate hua. ₹3.5 crore lapse ho gaya.

Mohalle doobe. Nadi gaandi hui.

Paisa tha. Plan tha. Iraada nahi tha.

Jab tak tum nahi poochhoge — koi nahi batayega.

Agle episode mein: Building Permission Ka Chakkar — Prashant ki factory ko extension chahiye. Usne dekha ki system kaise kaam karta hai.

episodes.synopsis: Every monsoon Ichalkaranji's lanes flood. Govind investigates drainage — open nali vs underground, the sewage treatment plan, and why the same streets flood every year despite budget allocations.
episodes.caption: Tumhara mohalla monsoon mein doobta hai? Kya tumhe pata hai ki drainage pe kitna budget allocate hua aur kitna kharcha hua? RTI se poochho. Comments mein batao — tumhare area ka monsoon ka kya haal hota hai.

episodes.title: Building Permission Ka Chakkar

slides.text:
Prashant Patil ko factory extend karni hai.

20 looms aur lagane hain. Jagah chahiye.

Usne socha — thoda construction kar leta hoon.

Govind ne roka: "Pehle permission le."

Prashant: "Permission? Idhar kisi ne li hai kabhi?"

Govind: "Isiliye toh problem hai."

Building permission ka legal process:

1. Architect se plan banwao (approved architect)
2. Application — mahanagarpalika building department
3. Documents: property papers, land use certificate, NOCs
4. Scrutiny fee pay karo
5. Site inspection
6. Approval — 60 din mein aana chahiye
7. Construction shuru karo — plan ke according
8. Completion certificate lo

Total legal time: 2-3 mahine.
Actual time: 6 mahine se 1 saal. Ya kabhi nahi.

Prashant ne architect se baat ki.

Architect: "Process seedha hai. Par..."

Prashant: "Par?"

Architect: "Inspector ko kuch dena padta hai. Nahi toh file aage nahi badhti. Har step pe."

Prashant: "Kitna?"

Architect: "Plan ke size pe depend karta hai. ₹20,000 se ₹2 lakh tak."

Yeh fees ke UPAR hai. Yeh official nahi hai. Par yeh "system" hai.

Ichalkaranji mein kitne buildings legally bane hain?

Estimate: 40-50% construction bina permission ke hua hai.

Kyun?
- Process lamba hai
- Rishwat deni padti hai
- "Sab kar rahe hain"
- Enforcement weak hai

Result: Unsafe buildings. No fire safety. Drainage problems. Insurance claim reject.

Bina permission ke construction karne ka risk:

1. Mahanagarpalika notice bhej sakti hai — demolition order
2. Fine — construction cost ka 5-10x tak
3. Property bechne mein problem — completion certificate nahi milega
4. Loan nahi milega — bank ko legal documents chahiye
5. Insurance claim reject — illegal structure pe coverage nahi

Sasta padta hai lagta hai. Mehnga padta hai baad mein.

Prashant ne legal route liya.

Govind: "Agar rishwat maange toh?"

Prashant: "Toh?"

Govind: "Likho. Record karo. Vigilance cell mein complaint karo. RTI karo — 'Ward 23 mein pichle saal kitne building permissions diye gaye? Average time kitna laga?'"

"System tabhi badlega jab log legal route lenge AUR rishwat dene se manaa karenge."

Agar tumhe building permission chahiye:

1. Approved architect se milna — list mahanagarpalika website pe hai
2. Application online submit karo (agar portal hai)
3. Fees receipt rakho — koi extra nahi dena
4. 60 din mein response na aaye — written follow-up karo
5. Rishwat maange? Vigilance cell: complaint likho

Legal route mushkil hai. Par sahi hai.

Prashant ka permission 4 mahine mein aaya.

Bina rishwat ke. Legal route se.

Mushkil tha? Haan.
Time laga? Haan.
Par ab uski factory LEGAL hai. Safe hai. Bech sakta hai. Loan le sakta hai.

"System" tabhi badlega jab hum badlenge.

episodes.caption: Tumhara ghar legally bana hai? Building permission hai? Completion certificate hai? Agar nahi — toh jaano kya risk hai aur kaise legal karo. Comments mein batao — tumhare area mein kitne buildings bina permission ke bane hain?

episodes.title: Street Light Ke Neeche Andhera

slides.text:
Mahanagarpalika ne announce kiya — "5,000 LED street lights lagi!"

Photo op hua. Newspaper mein aaya.

Par Govind ki gali mein?

6 mein se 2 jal rahi hain.

Baaki 4 — band. Kab se? Kisi ko nahi pata.

Govind ne Tanvi ke saath milke kuch kiya jo kisi ne nahi kiya tha.

Paidal nikle. Ward 23 ki har gali.

Har street light count ki. Working ya nahi.

Result:
Total lights: 187
Working: 112
Not working: 75

40% band.

Govind ne list banayi. Pole number. Location. Status.

Ward office mein di.

Clerk: "Complaint register mein likh dijiye."

Govind: "Written acknowledgment do. Date aur stamp ke saath."

Clerk surprised tha. Par diya.

Likhit complaint = record. Record = accountability.

Street light maintenance kaise hona chahiye:

1. Dedicated electrical wing — mahanagarpalika mein
2. Complaint helpline — 24/7
3. Response time: 48 hours max
4. Ward-wise light audit — yearly
5. AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) — contractor responsible

Agar AMC hai — toh contractor ki zimmedaari hai repair karna.
Agar AMC nahi hai — toh mahanagarpalika ki.

Dono case mein — TUMHARA haq hai working street light.

Street light sirf roshni nahi hai.

Yeh SAFETY hai.

- Women's safety — andheri gali mein kaun jaaye?
- Accident prevention — gaadhe dikhne chahiye
- Crime deterrent — andhera = chhupa hua khatra

Agar 40% lights band hain — toh 40% ward UNSAFE hai.

Yeh civic amenity nahi — yeh fundamental safety infrastructure hai.

Govind ne RTI file ki:

"Ward 23 mein street lights ka AMC kiski company ke paas hai?
Contract value kya hai?
Pichle 6 mahine mein kitni complaints aayi aur kitni resolve hui?"

Data maango. Data se sawaal poochho.

"5000 lights lagi" — yeh announcement hai.
"Kitni chal rahi hain" — yeh accountability hai.

Tum bhi kar sakte ho:

1. Apni gali ki street lights count karo — working vs band
2. Complaint karo — LIKHIT mein, acknowledgment lo
3. Response nahi aaya 1 hafta mein? Nagar sevak ko bolo
4. RTI: "Ward __ ka AMC contractor kaun? Response time kya hai?"
5. Group mein maango — ek gali ke 10 log milke maangein = asar zyada

2 hafte baad — Govind ki gali ki 4 lights repair ho gayi.

Kyun? Kyunki written complaint thi. Record tha. Follow-up hua.

Andhera tabhi rehta hai jab koi bolata nahi.

episodes.synopsis: LED street lights were installed but many don't work. Govind maps his ward's working vs non-working lights and confronts the gap between installation announcements and actual maintenance.
episodes.caption: Tumhari gali mein kitni street lights hain? Kitni chal rahi hain? Count karo aaj — aur complaint karo likhit mein. Comments mein batao — tumhare ward mein light ka kya scene hai.

episodes.title: Janam Se Mrityu Tak

slides.text:
Prashant ki beti ka school admission reject ho gaya.

Reason: Birth certificate mein naam galat hai.

Correction ke liye — mahanagarpalika.

Application diya. 3 mahine ho gaye. Koi response nahi.

Birth certificate. Death certificate. Marriage certificate.

Yeh sab mahanagarpalika deti hai. Ya deni chahiye.

Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969:

Mahanagarpalika ka kaam hai:
1. Har birth register karna — 21 din ke andar
2. Har death register karna — 21 din ke andar
3. Certificate issue karna — defined timeline mein
4. Records maintain karna — permanently

21 din ke baad? Late fee lagti hai.
1 saal ke baad? Court order chahiye.

Time pe register karo — nahi toh chakkar shuru.

Common problems:

1. Naam galat — spelling mistake registration mein
2. Date galat — 1-2 din ka farak school/passport mein problem
3. Late registration — hospital ne kiya hi nahi
4. Death certificate delay — property transfer ruk jaata hai
5. Online system — hai par kaam nahi karta

Har problem ka solution MAHANAGARPALIKA ke paas hai.
Par log jaante nahi ki maangein kaise.

Prashant ka case:

Govind ne kaha — "Written application do. Date likho. Acknowledgment lo."

"Aur saath mein RTI file karo: 'Birth certificate correction ka standard timeline kya hai? Pichle 6 mahine mein kitne correction applications pending hain?'"

2 hafte mein Prashant ko corrected certificate mil gaya.

RTI file karne ke BAAD.

Coincidence? Shayad nahi.

Birth certificate kaise banwayein:
1. Hospital discharge summary lekar jao
2. Mahanagarpalika birth registration office
3. Form bharo — 21 din ke andar
4. Certificate 7-15 din mein milna chahiye

Death certificate:
1. Doctor ka death declaration
2. Mahanagarpalika mein 21 din ke andar
3. Certificate zaruri hai — property, pension, insurance ke liye

Dono FREE hain timeline ke andar.

Maharashtra mein online system hai — crsorgi.gov.in

Yahan se:
- Birth/death registration online
- Certificate download
- Correction application

Par Ichalkaranji mein kitna functional hai?

Govind ne try kiya — portal pe "server error."

"Digital India ban raha hai. Server toh chalna chahiye."

Check karo:

1. Tumhara birth certificate hai? Naam sahi hai?
2. Ghar mein kisi ka death certificate pending hai?
3. Bacche ka birth 21 din mein register hua?
4. Online portal kaam karta hai? Try karo — crsorgi.gov.in

Problems hain? Written complaint karo. RTI karo.

Yeh basic DOCUMENTS hain. Yeh tumhara FUNDAMENTAL right hai.

Janam se mrityu tak — mahanagarpalika tumhari zindagi ke har bade document mein hai.

Birth. Marriage. Death.

School admission se lekar property transfer tak.

Yeh boring hai. Glamorous nahi hai.

Par galat hua toh — saalon ka chakkar hai.

Sahi karo. Time pe karo. Sawaal poochho.

Agle episode mein: Budget Kaise Banta Hai? — ₹500 crore ka faisla kaun karta hai?

episodes.synopsis: The unglamorous but critical duty — birth registration, death registration, marriage registration. Govind discovers that delayed registrations cause real problems for real people.
episodes.caption: Tumhara birth certificate sahi hai? Correction chahiye? Kya pata hai ki 21 din ke baad late fee lagti hai aur 1 saal baad court order chahiye? Check karo aaj. Comments mein batao — tumhe kabhi certificate ka chakkar pada?

episodes.title: Budget Kaise Banta Hai?

slides.text:
₹500-800 crore.

Itna paisa har saal Ichalkaranji Mahanagarpalika ke haath mein aata hai.

Kaun decide karta hai ki yeh paisa kahan jayega?

Tum? Nahi.
Tumhara nagar sevak? Thoda.

Toh kaun?

Aaj samjho — budget kaise banta hai.

Municipal budget process:

1. Municipal Commissioner ka office DRAFT budget banata hai (January-February)
2. Standing Committee review karti hai (February-March)
3. Changes/amendments suggest hote hain
4. General Body mein present hota hai (March)
5. Corporators debate karte hain, vote karte hain
6. Budget APPROVE hota hai — April se lagu

Yeh process PUBLIC hai. Tum sun sakte ho.

Budget mein kaun kaun involved hai:

1. Municipal Commissioner — draft banata hai, asli power yahan hai
2. Standing Committee (Sthayi Samiti) — review, changes, most powerful committee
3. Mayor — chair karta hai, par override nahi kar sakta easily
4. Corporators — General Body mein vote karte hain
5. Citizens — objections/suggestions de sakte hain (TUMHARA HAQ)

Sabse important step? #5. Par log jaante hi nahi.

Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act — Section 100:

Draft budget PUBLIC hota hai.

Citizens ko 8 din milte hain — objections aur suggestions dene ke liye.

8 DIN.

Yeh tumhara LEGAL window hai budget mein bolne ka.

Par kitne log jaante hain? Kitne log use karte hain?

Govind ko bhi nahi pata tha — ab pata hai.

Typical municipal budget — paisa kahan jaata hai:

- Staff salaries & admin: 35-40%
- Infrastructure (roads, drainage): 20-25%
- Water supply: 10-15%
- Solid waste: 5-8%
- Health & education: 5-10%
- Debt repayment: 5-10%
- "Development" works: 10-15%

Sabse bada kharcha? SALARY.
Sabse kam? Woh jo tumhe seedha dikhta hai.

Budget mein yeh sawaal poochho:

1. Mere ward ka allocation kitna hai? (Sab wards equal nahi hote)
2. Pichle saal ka budget kitna kharcha hua? Kitna lapse hua?
3. Naye projects kaunse hain? Timeline kya hai?
4. Revenue kahan se aa raha hai? Property tax, grants, loans?
5. Kya koi naya tax ya cess propose hai?

Yeh sawaal likhit mein 8-din window mein do.

Budget season mein kya karo:

1. March mein dhyan do — draft budget public hoga
2. Newspaper/website check karo — notice aayega
3. 8 din ke andar LIKHIT objections/suggestions bhejo
4. General Body meeting attend karo — PUBLIC hai
5. Apne nagar sevak se poochho — "Mere ward ke liye kya maanga?"

Budget mein bolna = paisa kahan jaayega woh decide karna.

₹500-800 crore ka faisla ho raha hai.

Tumhare paise ka.

8 din milte hain bolne ke liye.

Use karo ya chup raho.

Govind use karega.

Agle episode mein: Prabhag Samiti Kya Hai? — ward level pe decisions kaise hote hain, aur tum kaise hissa ban sakte ho.

episodes.synopsis: Govind investigates how the municipal corporation budget is made — who proposes it, who approves it, and where citizens can intervene before the money is spent.
episodes.caption: ₹500-800 crore ka budget banta hai har saal. Tumhe 8 din milte hain objections dene ke liye. Kya tumne kabhi diya? March mein dhyan do — draft budget public hota hai. Comments mein batao — tumhe apne ward ka allocation pata hai?

episodes.title: Prabhag Samiti Kya Hai?

slides.text:
Tumhare ward mein ek committee hai.

Jo tumhare ward ke kaam decide karti hai.

Sadak, nali, light, kachra — sab.

Iska naam hai: Prabhag Samiti.

Kya tumhe pata tha?

Govind ko bhi nahi pata tha.

Prabhag Samiti = Ward Committee

- Har 3-4 wards milke ek Prabhag banta hai
- Prabhag Samiti mein un wards ke nagar sevak hote hain
- Ek chairman hota hai (nagar sevak mein se)
- Monthly meeting honi chahiye
- Ward level ke kaam yahan decide hote hain

Yeh tumhara SABSE KAREEB ka governance body hai.

State government nahi — yeh hai.

Prabhag Samiti kya kar sakti hai:

1. Ward ka development plan banaye
2. Ward fund ka kharcha approve kare
3. Local complaints pe action le
4. Contractors ke kaam ki quality check kare
5. Mahanagarpalika ko ward ki priorities bataye

Yeh committee tumhare SABSE KAREEB hai.

Aur iske meetings mein tum JA SAKTE HO.

Govind pehli prabhag samiti meeting mein gaya.

Kya mila:
- 5 nagar sevak baithey the
- 2 nagrikon ne aaye the (Govind + ek aur uncle)
- Meeting 20 minute mein khatam
- 3 proposals approve hue — bina discussion ke
- Minutes? "Baad mein milenge."

Govind: "Yeh meeting hai ya formality?"

Prabhag samiti kyun fail hoti hai:

1. Log jaante nahi ki exist karti hai
2. Meeting ka schedule public nahi hota
3. Agenda pehle se share nahi hota
4. Nagrik aate nahi — toh nagar sevak jaise chahein waise karte hain
5. Minutes record nahi hote ya publicly available nahi hote

Result: Ward level pe decisions bina public input ke hote hain.

Tumhara paisa. Bina tumhari awaaz ke.

Govind ne kiya:

1. RTI file ki: "Prabhag 8 ki pichle 6 mahine ki meeting dates, attendance, aur minutes dijiye."
2. Apne mohalle ke 10 logon ko bataya ki meeting exist karti hai
3. Agla meeting — 8 nagrik aaye
4. Sawaal poochhe — drainage ka kaam kab hoga? Street light ka contractor kaun?

8 log aaye — aur meeting 20 minute se 1.5 ghante ho gayi.

Tum kya kar sakte ho:

1. RTI: "Mera prabhag kaun sa hai? Samiti ki meeting kab hoti hai?"
2. Ward office se meeting schedule maango
3. Ek meeting attend karo — bas ek baar
4. Ek sawaal poochho — jo tumhe sabse zyada affect karta hai
5. 5 padosiyon ko le jao — numbers matter

Jab 20 log meeting mein aayenge — nagar sevak ko jawab dena padega.

Prabhag Samiti tumhara sabse kareeb ka governance system hai.

Par sirf tab kaam karta hai jab tum AATE ho.

Khali kursiyan = koi jawabdehri nahi.

Bhari kursiyan = har sawaal ka jawab.

Govind 8 logon ke saath gaya. Tum kitne lekar jaoge?

Agle episode mein: Sthayi Samiti — asli power kaun? Standing committee samjho.

episodes.synopsis: Ward committees (prabhag samiti) exist so decisions happen closer to citizens. Govind attends one — and finds out most people don't even know they can.
episodes.caption: Tumhare ward ki prabhag samiti ki meeting kab hoti hai? Pata hai? Nahi pata — toh RTI karo aur ek baar jaake dekho. 5 padosi le jao. Comments mein batao — kya tumne kabhi ward meeting attend ki hai?

episodes.title: Sthayi Samiti — Asli Power

slides.text:
Municipal Corporation mein sabse powerful kaun hai?

Mayor? Nahi.
Commissioner? Thoda.

Asli power? STHAYI SAMITI.

Standing Committee.

Yeh committee APPROVE karti hai — budget, tenders, appointments, projects.

Bina iske approval ke — kuch nahi hota.

Sthayi Samiti:

- Corporators mein se chune jaate hain — General Body mein
- Typically 12-16 members
- Chairman — sabse powerful position (mayor ke baad)
- Monthly meetings — sab proposals yahan aate hain
- Approve ya reject karte hain: budget, contracts, land use, new posts

Jo bhi paisa kharch hona hai — yahan se guzarta hai.

Sthayi Samiti kya approve karti hai:

1. Annual Budget
2. Tenders — ₹5 lakh se upar ke sab
3. New staff appointments
4. Land use changes
5. Development project approvals
6. Contract extensions

Matlab — shaher ka ZYAADATAR paisa yahan se decide hota hai.

Aur yeh meetings? Mostly behind closed doors.

Problem:

1. Meetings public nahi hoti — technically honi chahiye
2. Agenda pehle se available nahi hota
3. Minutes publish hone mein mahine lagte hain
4. Opposition corporators ko time nahi milta
5. Public ko pata hi nahi chalta kya approve hua

Itna paisa. Itni power. Itni kam transparency.

Yeh system design nahi hai — yeh system failure hai.

Tumhare rights:

1. Sthayi Samiti ki meetings ka schedule — PUBLIC hona chahiye
2. Agenda — pehle se available hona chahiye
3. Minutes — website pe publish hone chahiye
4. Tenders ka record — RTI se maang sakte ho
5. Koi bhi nagrik objection bhej sakta hai agar koi proposal galat lage

Sawaal poochho. Record maango.

Govind ne 3 RTI file ki:

1. "Sthayi Samiti ki pichle 1 saal ki meeting dates aur attendance"
2. "₹1 crore se upar ke approve hue tenders ki list — contractor naam sahit"
3. "Sthayi Samiti ke members ki list aur unki party affiliation"

Public ka paisa. Public information.

"Agar yeh sab chhupana padta hai — toh sawaal yeh hai ki kyun chhupa rahe hain."

Tum kya karo:

1. Sthayi Samiti members kaun hain — jaano
2. RTI: meeting minutes maango pichle 6 mahine ke
3. Bade tenders kaunse approve hue — list maango
4. Newspaper mein tender notice aaye — padho
5. Apne nagar sevak se poochho: "Sthayi Samiti mein kya approve hua pichle mahine?"

Power tab tak unchecked hai jab tak koi check nahi karta.

Sthayi Samiti — naam suna nahi hoga.

Par tumhare sheher ka sabse bada faisla yahi leti hai.

Budget. Tender. Project.

Tumhara paisa. Unka faisla.

Jab tak tum nahi jaanoge — woh nahi batayenge.

Agle episode mein: Mayor Ka Kaam Kya Hai? — Mayor vs Commissioner. Elected vs Appointed. Asli power kiske paas?

episodes.synopsis: The Standing Committee is the most powerful body in a municipal corporation — more powerful than the mayor in many ways. Govind breaks down who's on it, what they approve, and why citizens should care.
episodes.caption: Sthayi Samiti — naam suna hai? Yeh committee tumhare sheher ka sabse bada faisla leti hai. Budget se tenders tak. Kya tumhe pata hai tumhare sheher ki sthayi samiti mein kaun hai? RTI karo. Comments mein batao.

episodes.title: Mayor Ka Kaam Kya Hai?

slides.text:
Sabko lagta hai Mayor sheher chalata hai.

Galat.

Mayor ELECTED hai — par uski power LIMITED hai.

Sheher ka daily kaam? Municipal Commissioner chalata hai.

Commissioner APPOINTED hai — state government dwaara.

Elected vs Appointed.

Kaun zyada powerful? Chaliye dekhte hain.

Mayor ka kaam:

1. General Body meetings ki chair karna
2. Sheher ka ceremonial head — functions, dignitaries
3. Presiding officer — meetings mein order maintain karna
4. Emergency powers — limited situations mein
5. Public se milna — grievances sunna

Matlab — Mayor ek PRESIDING OFFICER hai.
Executive power? Bahut kam.

Municipal Commissioner ka kaam:

1. Corporation ka CEO — daily operations
2. Staff hire/fire karna
3. Budget implement karna
4. Tenders approve karna (certain limits tak)
5. Law enforcement — encroachment, building violations
6. All departments report to Commissioner

IAS/State cadre officer. State government appoint karti hai.

Matlab — jo banda sheher chalata hai, usse Ichalkaranji ke logon ne CHUNA nahi.

Yeh design intentional hai.

Elected body (Mayor + Corporators) = policy decisions
Appointed officer (Commissioner) = execution

Idea yeh hai ki professional officer implement kare, elected leaders direction dein.

Par tension tab aata hai jab:
- Commissioner political pressure mein kaam kare
- Mayor executive decisions mein interfere kare
- Dono ek doosre ko blame karein

Public? Beech mein phanse.

Mayor ko accountable kaise rakhein:
- Vote se. 5 saal baad judge karo.
- General Body meetings attend karo — public hai.
- Performance track karo — kya promises poore hue?

Commissioner ko accountable kaise rakhein:
- RTI se — har department ka data maango
- Written complaints — record pe rahein
- State government ko likho — agar Commissioner kaam nahi kar raha

Dono ko accountable rakhna TUMHARA kaam hai.

Govind ne ek important baat samjhi:

"Problem yeh nahi ki Mayor powerful nahi hai ya Commissioner appointed hai.

Problem yeh hai ki 3.5 lakh log DONO ko accountable nahi rakh rahe.

System mein tools hain — RTI, meetings, complaints, vote.

Tools use nahi ho rahe.

Isiliye system kaam nahi karta."

Jaano:

1. Ichalkaranji ka Mayor kaun hai? — Google karo ya mahanagarpalika website
2. Commissioner kaun hai? — Same
3. Dono se milne ka process kya hai? — Ward office se poochho
4. Mayor se milna hai? — Nagrik darbaar hota hai
5. Commissioner ko likhna hai? — Written application ya RTI

Pehchaan banakar rakho — yeh tumhare REPRESENTATIVES hain.

Mayor = direction deta hai.
Commissioner = execute karta hai.
Sthayi Samiti = approve karti hai.
Nagar Sevak = ward ka awaaz hai.

Aur tum?

Tum IN SABKO accountable rakhne wale ho.

Agar tum nahi poochhoge — koi nahi batayega.

Agle episode mein: Health Department Kahan Hai? — mahanagarpalika ka health wing kya karta hai, aur tumhare sheher mein public health ka kya haal hai.

episodes.synopsis: People think the Mayor runs the city. But the Municipal Commissioner — an IAS officer appointed by the state — holds most executive power. Govind breaks down who does what.
episodes.caption: Mayor sheher chalata hai? Galat. Commissioner chalata hai — aur usse state government appoint karti hai. Kya tumhe dono ka naam pata hai? Comments mein batao — tumhare sheher ka Mayor aur Commissioner kaun hai?

episodes.title: Health Department Kahan Hai?

slides.text:
Monsoon ke baad Ward 23 mein dengue ke 15 cases aaye.

Hospital mein beds nahi the. Private hospital mein ₹30,000 ka bill.

Govind ne socha — mahanagarpalika ka health department kya kar raha hai?

Fogging hua? Nahi.
Awareness camp? Nahi.

₹500 crore ka budget hai — health pe kitna?

Mahanagarpalika ka Health Department — kya karna chahiye:

1. Public hospitals/dispensaries chalana
2. Epidemic control — fogging, awareness, rapid response
3. Food safety inspections — restaurants, street food, markets
4. Vaccination programs
5. Malaria/dengue/sanitation surveillance
6. Birth & death medical certification
7. Water quality testing

7 mandatory duties. Kitne ho rahe hain?

Ichalkaranji mein:

- Municipal hospital: hai — par staff shortage, limited equipment
- Dispensaries: kuch wards mein hai, baaki mein nahi
- Fogging: "budget nahi hai" — monsoon ke BAAD bola
- Food inspection: last inspection kab hua? Koi nahi jaanta
- Water testing: results public nahi hain

Dengue ka outbreak ek FAILURE hai — system ka, planning ka, execution ka.

Govind ne health budget RTI se maanga.

Total health allocation: budget ka 6%.

Kharcha: 4.5% — baaki LAPSE.

Dengue fogging ka budget: ₹8 lakh.
Kharcha: ₹2.5 lakh.

"Budget kam nahi tha. Kharcha kam tha.

Paisa tha — iraada nahi tha."

Food safety — mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari.

Restaurant license dena.
Regular inspection karna.
Adulteration check karna.
Street food hygiene monitor karna.

Ichalkaranji mein kitne restaurants inspect hue pichle saal?

Govind ne RTI file ki.

Jawab aaya: 23.

Pure sheher mein. Saal bhar mein. 23.

Kitne restaurants hain? Hazaaron.

Tumhare health rights:

1. Municipal hospital mein basic treatment — free ya nominal cost
2. Epidemic outbreak pe rapid response — fogging, awareness, camps
3. Food safety complaint — mahanagarpalika ko karo
4. Water quality report — public hona chahiye
5. Vaccination — free government vaccines available hone chahiye

Yeh PUBLIC HEALTH hai — tumhara fundamental right.

Kya karo:

1. RTI: "Health department mein kitne doctors hain? Kitne posts vacant?"
2. Food complaint: adulteration ya hygiene issue? Likhit complaint do
3. Dengue/malaria: fogging nahi hua? Ward office mein complaint karo
4. Municipal hospital ki condition: photo lo, social media pe daalo
5. Health budget: pichle saal ka kharcha RTI se maango

Health pe chup mat raho — yeh zindagi ka sawaal hai.

Dengue ke 15 cases.

₹30,000 ka private hospital ka bill.

₹8 lakh fogging budget mein se ₹2.5 lakh kharcha.

Yeh negligence hai. Yeh accountability ka sawaal hai.

Tumhara tax health ke liye bhi jaata hai.

Tumhari health tumhara haq hai.

Agle episode mein: School Aur Hospital — mahanagarpalika ke schools aur hospitals kaun chalayega?

episodes.synopsis: A dengue outbreak in Ichalkaranji makes Govind ask — where is the corporation's health department? What are they supposed to do? Who checks food safety? Who controls epidemics?
episodes.caption: Tumhare area mein dengue/malaria ka outbreak hua? Fogging hua? Municipal hospital mein doctors hain? RTI karo — health department ka budget aur kharcha maango. Comments mein batao — tumhare ward mein health services ka kya haal hai?

episodes.title: School Aur Hospital — Kaun Chalayega?

slides.text:
Mahanagarpalika ke apne schools hote hain.
Apne hospitals hote hain.

Ichalkaranji Mahanagarpalika ke kitne schools hain?
Kitne teachers hain?
Kitne students hain?

Govind — retired teacher — yeh jaanne gaya.

Jo mila woh uncomfortable tha.

Municipal schools — mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari:

1. Free primary education — RTE ke under
2. Mid-day meal scheme
3. Infrastructure — building, toilet, drinking water
4. Teachers — trained, adequate numbers
5. Books aur materials — free

Yeh GUARANTEE hai. Par ground pe?

Govind ek municipal school gaya.

4 classrooms. 2 teachers. 85 students.

Ek teacher 2 classes ek saath padha rahi thi.

Toilet — ek working, ek band.

Mid-day meal — dal-chawal. Roz wahi.

Playground — construction material pada tha.

"Main 35 saal teacher raha. Yeh school nahi — yeh majboori hai."

Municipal hospital:

Doctors: 3 (sanctioned posts: 8)
Nurses: 5 (sanctioned: 12)
Beds: 30
OPD timing: 9-1 PM only

After 1 PM? "Private jao."

X-ray machine: band — 6 mahine se.

Ambulance: 1. Sheher mein 3.5 lakh log.

Yeh healthcare nahi — yeh pretend hai.

Education + Health combined: budget ka ~12%.

Par salary hi kha jaata hai zyaadatar.

Infrastructure pe? 2-3%.
New equipment? "Next year."
Teacher training? "Funds nahi hain."

12% sunne mein theek lagta hai.

Par jab 5 vacant posts fill nahi hoti — toh 12% bhi kya karega?

Tumhare rights:

1. Municipal school mein free admission — RTE ke under
2. Mid-day meal — roz, nutritious
3. Municipal hospital mein basic treatment — free/nominal
4. Vacant posts ki RTI — kitne sanctioned, kitne filled?
5. Infrastructure complaints — likhit mein, acknowledgment lo

Yeh services tumhare TAX se chalti hain. Quality DEMAND karo.

Govind ne kiya:

1. RTI: Municipal schools mein kitne teachers sanctioned vs working?
2. RTI: Hospital mein kitne doctors sanctioned vs working?
3. School visit — photo document kiya condition
4. Parent-teacher meeting mein jaake sawaal uthaye
5. Commissioner ko letter likha — vacant posts fill karo

"Bacche padh rahe hain — lekin system padha nahi raha."

Municipal school mein bacche padh rahe hain — 2 teachers se, tootey bench pe.

Municipal hospital mein mareez aa rahe hain — 3 doctors ke paas, band X-ray ke saath.

Yeh log himmat wale hain — system kamzor hai.

System tabhi mazboot hoga jab tum poochhoge.

episodes.title: Bazaar Ka License

slides.text:
Prashant ka trade license expire ho gaya.

Renew karne gaya. 4 ghante lage.

3 counters. 2 baar wapas bheja. "Yeh form galat hai."

Fees: ₹2,500.
"Jaldi chahiye toh..." — hint samajh gaye.

Prashant ke aas-paas ke 10 loom owners mein se 6 ka license expired hai.

"Koi poochhta hi nahi toh renew kyun karein?"

Businesses ko yeh chahiye mahanagarpalika se:

1. Trade License — har business ke liye mandatory
2. Shop & Establishment Registration
3. Food License (FSSAI) — restaurants/food businesses
4. Fire NOC — factories, commercial buildings
5. Signboard permission
6. Pollution NOC — industries

Har ek ka fee hai. Har ek ka renewal hai.
Har ek ka inspector hai.

Kyun businesses skip karte hain:

1. Process complicated — multiple visits
2. "Speed money" expected — bina diye file nahi chalti
3. Inspector raj — random inspections, harassment
4. Online system nahi ya kaam nahi karta
5. Penalty enforcement weak — toh risk kam

Result: Jo honest hai woh pareshan. Jo skip karta hai woh chal jaata hai.

System ulta kaam kar raha hai.

Business owners ke rights:

1. License application ka timeline DEFINED hai — 30 din
2. Reject hua toh REASON likhit mein milna chahiye
3. Inspector aaye toh ID dikhana padega
4. Inspection ka notice pehle aana chahiye
5. Rishwat maange? Vigilance cell mein complaint
6. Online application available hona chahiye

Tum customer ho — mahanagarpalika service provider hai.

Aur hawkers?

Street vendors ka bhi haq hai:

- Street Vendors Act, 2014 — legal protection
- Town Vending Committee — mahanagarpalika mein hona chahiye
- Vending zones designate hone chahiye
- License milna chahiye — toh harassment na ho

Ichalkaranji mein textile market ke bahar hazaaron hawkers hain.

Kitne licensed? Govind ne RTI file ki.

Ichalkaranji = textile city.

1.25 lakh power looms.

Har ek ko compliance chahiye.

Par system itna complicated hai ki chhote loom owners skip karte hain.

Result:
- Worker safety compromised
- No insurance
- Fire risk
- Pollution unchecked

Mahanagarpalika ka kaam hai — compliance EASY banao, not impossible.

Business owners — kya karo:

1. License renew karo — mushkil hai par zaruri hai
2. Fees receipt lo — extra kuch mat do
3. Process mein problem? Written complaint, RTI
4. Trade association ke through collectively maango — online system
5. Rishwat demand? Record karo, vigilance complaint

Citizens:
- Unlicensed business se service le rahe ho? Risk tumhara bhi hai

Prashant ka license renew hua. 4 ghante lage. Par legal hai.

Uske aas-paas ke 6 owners ka? Abhi bhi expired.

Jab system mushkil hota hai — log shortcut lete hain.

Par system tabhi easy hoga jab log DEMAND karenge.

episodes.title: Property Tax Kaise Calculate Hota Hai?

slides.text:
₹11,400 ka bill aaya tha.

Govind ne accept kar liya — initially.

Phir socha — yeh calculate kaise hua?

Kya formula hai? Kya mere ghar ka assessment sahi hai?

Kya main OVERCHARGE ho raha hoon?

Aaj woh formula samjhega — aur tum bhi.

Property Tax formula (Capital Value method):

Tax = Property ka Capital Value × Tax Rate

Capital Value kaise decide hota hai:
- Location (zone)
- Plot size
- Built-up area
- Type of construction (RCC, load-bearing)
- Usage (residential, commercial, industrial)
- Age of building
- Floor

Har factor ka ek RATE hai. Sab milake value aati hai.

Ichalkaranji ko ZONES mein divide kiya gaya hai.

Zone A: Main market, commercial — highest rate
Zone B: Semi-commercial, main roads — medium
Zone C: Residential — lower
Zone D: Outskirts — lowest

Tumhara ghar kis zone mein hai — yeh tax ka SABSE BADA factor hai.

Galat zone mein daal diya? Overcharge.

Apna tax kaise check karo:

1. Bill pe dekho — assessment details section
2. Zone check karo — sahi hai?
3. Built-up area check karo — measured sahi hai?
4. Usage check karo — residential hai toh residential rate lagna chahiye
5. Age of building — purani building pe discount milta hai

Govind ne check kiya — uska zone SAHI tha. Par built-up area 10% zyada likha tha.

Usne correction maanga.

Self-Assessment scheme:

Kuch mahanagarpalika mein tum KHUD apna tax calculate kar sakte ho.

1. Online calculator use karo (agar available)
2. Apna zone, area, usage, age dalo
3. System tax calculate karega
4. Tum pay karo
5. Random verification hota hai — galat nikla toh penalty

Honest self-assessment = less harassment.

Ichalkaranji mein yeh system hai? Govind ne poochha.

Tax galat laga toh kya karo:

1. Objection file karo — mahanagarpalika tax department mein
2. Supporting documents do — property papers, measurement proof
3. Hearing milni chahiye — 30 din mein
4. Decision se agree nahi? Appeal karo — senior authority ko
5. Last resort — court

Par PEHLE objection file karo. Tax bharte raho — objection process alag hai.

Aaj karo:

1. Apna property tax bill nikalo
2. Assessment details check karo — zone, area, usage
3. Padosi se compare karo — similar property, similar tax?
4. Galat lagta hai? Written objection do — tax department mein
5. RTI: "Ward __ mein property tax collection rate kya hai? Kitne logon ne objection file kiya?"

Tax dena duty hai. Sahi tax dena RIGHT hai.

Govind ka built-up area 10% zyada tha.

Correction ke baad — tax ₹11,400 se ₹10,200 ho gaya.

₹1,200 bach gaye. Har saal.

Chhota amount? Shayad.

Par principle bada hai — SAHI tax lagana mahanagarpalika ki zimmedaari hai.

Check karo. Sawaal poochho.

episodes.caption: Tumhara property tax sahi calculate hua hai? Zone sahi hai? Area sahi hai? Aaj check karo — aur galat hai toh objection do. Comments mein batao — tumhara tax kitna hai aur kya tumne kabhi check kiya?

episodes.title: Complaint Kaise Karein?

slides.text:
Govind ne ab tak 12 RTI file ki hain.
8 complaints likhi hain.
3 ward meetings attend ki hain.

Kitna result aaya?

4 lights repair hui.
1 tax correction mila.
2 RTI replies useful the.

Baaki? Silence.

Complaint karna easy hai. Result lena — woh art hai.

Official complaint channels:

1. Ward office — written complaint, get acknowledgment
2. Mahanagarpalika helpline — phone number (if it works)
3. Online portal — agar functional hai
4. Nagrik Darbaar — Mayor se milne ka weekly slot
5. Written to Commissioner — registered post
6. RTI — jab information chahiye
7. First Appeal (RTI) — jab RTI ka jawab nahi aaya

7 channels. Sabse effective? #5 aur #6.

Complaint ka Golden Rule:

1. LIKHIT mein do — verbal se kuch nahi hota
2. DATE likho — tumhari aur unki
3. ACKNOWLEDGMENT lo — number ya stamp
4. COPY rakho — tumhare paas
5. FOLLOW UP karo — 7 din baad
6. ESCALATE karo — response na aaye toh upar bhejo

Likhit = record. Record = accountability.

Bina record ke — tumhari complaint exist hi nahi karti.

Koi nahi sun raha? Escalation ladder:

1. Ward office → 2. Nagar Sevak → 3. Zonal officer → 4. Commissioner → 5. Mayor (Nagrik Darbaar) → 6. RTI + First Appeal → 7. State government (Divisional Commissioner) → 8. Lokayukta

Har step pe LIKHIT mein jao.

Har step ka record rakho.

Patience chahiye. Par har step pe pressure badhta hai.

Complaint letter template:

To: [Officer designation]
Subject: Complaint regarding [specific issue]
Date: [date]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, [name], resident of [address], Ward [number], wish to bring to your notice that [specific problem with details].

This issue has been persisting since [date/duration].

I request you to [specific action needed] within [reasonable timeline].

I request written acknowledgment of this complaint.

Thanking you,
[Name, phone, address]

Akele complaint = ek file.

20 logon ki collective complaint = PRESSURE.

Govind ne seekha:

1. Mohalle ke logon ko ek saath lao
2. Ek COMMON complaint banao — signed by all
3. Saath mein ward office jao
4. Copy: nagar sevak, commissioner, newspaper

"Ek aadmi poochhe — ignore kar sakte hain.
20 log poochhein — ignore nahi kar sakte."

Digital tools:

1. WhatsApp group — mohalle ka, complaints track karo
2. Photo/video — evidence rakhne ke liye
3. Social media — jab official channels fail hoon
4. Email — Commissioner ko email karo (official ID website pe)
5. RTI online — rtionline.gov.in

Digital record = permanent record.

Par OFFICIAL channel PEHLE use karo. Social media LAST resort.

Complaint karna haar nahi hai — haq hai.

Result na aaye toh — haaro mat, escalate karo.

Govind ne 8 complaints likhi. 4 ka result aaya.

Baaki 4 ke liye — escalation chal raha hai.

"System slow hai. Par chup rehna — woh aur slow bana deta hai."

episodes.synopsis: How to file complaints that get results — official channels, written complaints, tracking, escalation. What to do when nobody listens.
episodes.caption: Complaint ki toh par result nahi aaya? Escalate karo — ward office se Commissioner se Lokayukta tak. Template save karo. 20 logon ki complaint > 1 ki complaint. Comments mein batao — tumhari complaint ka kya hua?

episodes.title: Tender Ka Khel

slides.text:
Ward 23 ki ek sadak ₹45 lakh mein bani.

6 mahine mein toot gayi.

Wahi contractor ko phir se contract mila — ₹38 lakh mein.

Wahi sadak. Wahi contractor. Do baar paisa.

Yeh accident nahi hai. Yeh SYSTEM hai.

Aur yeh system tabhi chalta hai jab koi dekh nahi raha.

Public tender process — kaise hona chahiye:

1. Department estimate banata hai
2. Tender notice — newspaper + website pe
3. Interested contractors bid karte hain (sealed)
4. Technical evaluation hoti hai
5. Financial bid open hoti hai
6. Lowest qualified bidder ko contract milta hai
7. Agreement sign hota hai
8. Kaam hota hai + quality inspection

Har step TRANSPARENT hona chahiye.

Rigging kaise hota hai:

1. Tender notice chhoti jagah pe, kam time ke liye — kam log apply karein
2. Technical conditions aise likhe ki sirf EK contractor qualify kare
3. Cartel — contractors aapas mein decide karte hain kaun bid karega
4. Estimate inflate — ₹30 lakh ka kaam ₹50 lakh mein dikhaya
5. Quality compromise — sasta material, payment poora

Yeh sab hota hai. Har sheher mein. Har saal.

Par yeh sab PUBLIC information hai.

1. Tender notice — newspaper mein aana chahiye
2. Bid details — RTI se maang sakte ho
3. Contractor ka naam — public record
4. Estimate vs actual cost — RTI se
5. Quality inspection report — RTI se
6. Contractor ki past performance — RTI se

Sab kuch maang sakte ho. KANOON hai.

Bas maangna padta hai.

Govind ne kiya:

1. Newspaper mein tender notices track karne laga
2. RTI: "Ward 23 ke pichle 2 saal ke ₹10 lakh+ tenders — contractor naam, bid amount, completion status"
3. Jo sadak do baar bani — uska poora trail maanga

Result: Ek pattern dikha.

3 contractors — 80% kaam.
Sab ek hi party se connected.

"Yeh coincidence nahi hai."

Tender monitor kaise karein:

1. Newspaper ke tender section padho — roz
2. Mahanagarpalika website pe tender section check karo
3. e-tender portal: mahatenders.gov.in
4. RTI: specific tender ka poora detail maango
5. Kaam ho raha hai? Site pe jao — dekho kya ho raha hai
6. Quality mein problem? Photo lo, complaint karo

Tender monitoring = corruption ka sabse effective check.

Start karo:

1. Apne ward mein chal rahe construction ka tender number poochho
2. RTI: "Yeh kaam kis tender se hua? Contractor kaun? Amount kitna?"
3. Kaam complete hone pe — quality check report maango
4. Guarantee period mein kaam toota? — Written complaint, contractor ko phir se banana padega
5. Pattern dikhta hai? — Data compile karo, newspaper ko do

Ek informed citizen = 100 inspectors.

₹45 lakh + ₹38 lakh = ₹83 lakh.

Ek sadak pe. Jo phir bhi theek nahi hai.

Yeh tumhara paisa hai.

Jab tak tum nahi dekhoge — woh dikhayenge nahi.

Agle episode mein: Govind Ki Petition — 200 hastaakshar, ek maang, Ward 23 ki drainage fix karo.

episodes.synopsis: How do public tenders work? Who gets the contracts? Govind discovers that tender documents are public — and citizens can monitor them.
episodes.caption: Tumhare ward mein kaunsa construction ho raha hai? Contractor kaun hai? Kitna tender tha? RTI karo — sab pata chalega. Comments mein batao — tumhare area mein koi sadak do baar bani hai?

episodes.title: Govind Ki Petition

slides.text:
Govind ne bahut RTI file ki.
Bahut complaints likhi.
Bahut meetings attend ki.

Par ab woh samajh gaya — akele ki awaaz sunai deti hai.

200 logon ki awaaz? Woh IGNORE nahi hoti.

Aaj woh petition banayega.

Ward 23 ka drainage — 3 saal se broken.

Har monsoon — paani ghutno tak.

Complaint kiya — "budget mein hai."
RTI kiya — "₹3.5 crore lapsed."
Nagar sevak se mila — "jaldi hoga."

Kuch nahi hua.

Govind ne socha — ab petition.

Petition kaise banayein:

1. Issue clearly define karo — specific location, specific problem
2. Kya maang rahe ho — specific solution, specific timeline
3. Petition letter likho — formal, factual, respectful
4. Hastaakshar (signatures) collect karo — naam, address, phone
5. Ward ke nagrikon se door-to-door jao
6. Petition submit karo — Commissioner, Mayor, Nagar Sevak — teeno ko
7. Copy: newspaper, social media

Numbers matter.

Govind, Tanvi aur Prashant — teen log.

Do hafte. Door-to-door.

"Ward 23 drainage fix karo" — ek simple maang.

Pehle din: 12 signatures.
Dooste din: 8.
Teesre din: 23 — kyunki pehle ke logon ne padosiyon ko bataya.

2 hafte mein: 214 signatures.

"Log CHAHTE hain bolna. Bas koi shuru kare."

Petition submit ki — teeno ko:

1. Municipal Commissioner — registered post + in person
2. Mayor — Nagrik Darbaar mein
3. Nagar Sevak Ashok Kale — haath mein diya

Har jagah — acknowledgment liya. Date. Stamp. Record.

Saath mein — newspaper ko copy bheji.

Ab ignore karna mushkil hai.

1 hafta: koi response nahi.

2 hafta: Nagar Sevak Kale ka phone aaya — "Govind sahab, meeting karein."

3 hafta: Commissioner office se letter — "Drainage repair ka proposal Standing Committee mein rakha jayega."

4 hafta: Local newspaper mein story — "Ward 23 ke 214 nagrikon ki petition."

214 hastaakshar ne woh kiya jo 12 RTI nahi kar payi.

Petition ka lesson:

1. RTI = information. Petition = ACTION.
2. 1 complaint ignore ho sakti hai. 200 nahi.
3. Newspaper coverage = political pressure
4. Record rakhna ZARURI hai — har step pe
5. Patient raho — system slow hai, par responsive hai jab pressure ho

"System kaam nahi karta" — galat.
"System tab kaam karta hai jab log kaam karwate hain" — sahi.

3 saal se band nali.

12 RTI. 8 complaints.

1 petition. 214 hastaakshar.

Aur ab — drainage repair ka proposal Standing Committee mein hai.

Govind ne system nahi toda. System USE kiya.

Tumhare ward mein kya problem hai?
200 log milke maangein — dekhna kya hota hai.

Agle episode mein: Election Kab? — municipal election kaise hota hai, aur tumhara local vote kyun sabse important hai.

episodes.title: Election Kab?

slides.text:
Lok Sabha election mein kitne log vote karte hain? 65-70%.

Municipal election mein? 45-55%.

Jo sarkar tumhari ROZI, SADAK, PAANI, SAFAI decide karti hai — usmein sabse KAM vote?

Yeh sabse badi galti hai jo Ichalkaranji ke log kar rahe hain.

Municipal election kaise hota hai:

1. 65 wards — har ward se 1 corporator
2. Direct election — tum seedha chunte ho
3. Term: 5 saal
4. Reservation: SC/ST/OBC/Women — wards rotate karte hain
5. Mayor — corporators mein se chunte hain (indirect)
6. State Election Commission conduct karti hai

Tumhara vote = tumhara nagar sevak = tumhare ward ka faisla.

Ward reservation:

- SC/ST wards — reserved proportionally
- OBC wards — reserved (27%)
- Women — 50% seats reserved (across all categories)

Har election mein wards ROTATE hote hain.

Matlab — tumhara ward is baar general ho sakta hai, agle baar reserved.

Yeh ensure karta hai — har community ko representation mile.

Local vote kyun sabse important hai:

1. PM tumhari nali nahi kholega — nagar sevak kholega
2. MLA tumhari sadak nahi banayega — corporation banayegi
3. MP tumhara kachra nahi uthayega — ward office uthayega

Jo government tumhari DAILY LIFE control karti hai — woh LOCAL hai.

Par tum usmein vote nahi karte.

Informed vote kaise dein:

1. Candidate kaun hai — pata karo
2. Uski background kya hai — criminal record check (myneta.info)
3. Incumbent hai toh — pichle 5 saal mein kya kiya? RTI se pata karo
4. Ward ka kya haal hai — drainage, sadak, paani. Kaun fix karega?
5. Party se zyada CANDIDATE dekho — local election mein vyakti matter karta hai

Blind vote = wasted vote.

Govind ka Ward 23 — Ashok Kale.

Govind ne 6 mahine mein seekha:
- Kale kabhi kabhi responsive hai
- Discretionary fund ka use questionable hai
- Ward meetings formality hain
- Par jab public aati hai — Kale kaam karta hai

"Agle election mein — main jaanunga ki kya poochhna hai.
Aur main akela nahi poochhunga."

Election se pehle karo:

1. Voter list mein naam check karo — nvsp.in
2. Ward number confirm karo
3. Candidates ki list dekho — State Election Commission website
4. Criminal record check — myneta.info
5. Incumbent se poochho — 5 saal mein kya kiya?
6. Candidate se poochho — tumhare ward ke liye kya plan hai?

Vote karo. Par JAANKE vote karo.

65 wards. 65 corporators. 5 saal ka faisla.

Tumhara vote decide karta hai — tumhari sadak kaisi hogi, paani kab aayega, kachra kaun uthayega.

Yeh PM ka election nahi hai.

Yeh TUMHARI ZINDAGI ka election hai.

Vote karo. Jaanke karo.

Agle episode mein: Pimpri-Chinchwad Ne Kya Kiya? — ek city jo corporation banne ke baad BADLI. Lessons for Ichalkaranji.

episodes.synopsis: Municipal elections — how corporators are elected, ward reservation, why your local vote matters more than any other election. Govind makes the case for informed local voting.
episodes.caption: Municipal election mein kitne log vote karte hain? 50%. Jo sarkar tumhari sadak, paani, safai decide karti hai — usmein aadhe log vote nahi karte. Agle election mein jaanke vote karo. Comments mein batao — tumhe apne nagar sevak ka naam pata hai?

episodes.title: Pimpri-Chinchwad Ne Kya Kiya?

slides.text:
Pimpri-Chinchwad.

1982 mein Municipal Corporation bani.

Tab: dusty industrial suburb. Auto plants aur chawls.

Aaj: India ki 7th cleanest city. Smart city. ₹4,000 crore+ budget.

Kya badla? Kaise badla?

Aur Ichalkaranji kya seekh sakta hai?

PCMC ka sabse bada achievement: 24x7 water supply pilot.

3 zones mein — continuous water. Metered. Monitored.

Kaise kiya:
1. Pipeline replacement — old lines hatai
2. DMA (District Metering Areas) — leakage track kiya
3. Smart meters — usage monitor
4. Public-private partnership

Result: Leakage 40% se 15% tak aayi.

Ichalkaranji ki leakage? Abhi bhi 30-40%.

PCMC ka road network:

- Concrete roads — 15 saal life, not 2
- Ward-wise priority system — transparent
- Online complaint tracking — har complaint ka status online
- Contractor blacklisting — quality kharab? Ban for 3 years

Ichalkaranji mein? Wahi contractor do baar same sadak bana raha hai.

Difference: ACCOUNTABILITY.

PCMC ka digital transformation:

1. Online property tax payment
2. Online building permission
3. Complaint portal with tracking
4. Budget documents online — searchable
5. GIS mapping — har road, har drain mapped

Transparency technology se aayi.

Ichalkaranji mein website pe "server error" aata hai.

Yeh budget ka nahi — PRIORITY ka sawaal hai.

Par PCMC bhi perfect nahi hai.

Corruption hai. Delays hain. Politics hai.

Jo farak pada — CITIZENS.

PCMC mein active citizen groups hain.
RTI activists hain.
Ward meetings mein log AATE hain.
Newspaper actively cover karta hai.

System wahi hai. PRESSURE alag hai.

Ichalkaranji mein woh pressure Govind bana raha hai.

Ichalkaranji ke liye lessons:

1. Technology lao — online payments, complaints, tracking
2. Pipeline replace karo — 30 saal purani infrastructure nahi chalegi
3. Contractor accountability — blacklisting system banao
4. Ward meetings REAL banao — agenda pehle, minutes public
5. Citizen groups ko encourage karo — RTI help desks
6. Data publish karo — budget, tenders, performance

Yeh sab POSSIBLE hai. Budget hai. Law hai. Staff hai.

Bas DEMAND karo.

Tum kya maang sakte ho:

1. Online complaint portal — functional, tracked
2. Ward budget online — searchable
3. Tender documents online — downloadable
4. 24x7 water supply ROADMAP — timeline ke saath
5. Contractor performance data — public

Yeh demand karo — individually aur collectively.

PCMC ne 40 saal liye. Ichalkaranji ko itna wait nahi karna chahiye.

Pimpri-Chinchwad 1982 mein wahi tha jahan Ichalkaranji aaj hai.

Dusty. Industrial. "Chalta hai" attitude.

44 saal lage badalne mein.

Par badla.

Ichalkaranji KO bhi badalna padega.

Aur woh badlaav TUMS se shuru hoga.

Agle episode mein: Sunanda Bhi Gayi — "kuch nahi hoga" wali Sunanda pehli baar ward meeting mein gayi.

episodes.title: Sunanda Bhi Gayi

slides.text:
Episode 1 mein Sunanda ne kaha tha:

"Bharo. Sab bhar rahe hain."

Tab se 6 mahine ho gaye.

Govind ne 12 RTI file ki.
8 complaints likhi.
200 logon ki petition banayi.

Sunanda roz dekhti rahi. Kuch nahi boli.

Aaj woh boli.

Sunanda ka trigger:

Mohalle mein ek bacchi school se ghar aa rahi thi. Andheri gali — street light band.

Ladkhadayi. Gir gayi. Haath toot gaya.

Sunanda ne kaha: "Yeh 6 mahine pehle complaint ki thi Govind ne. Light abhi bhi band hai."

Govind: "Haan."

Sunanda: "Meeting kab hai?"

Sunanda pehli baar prabhag samiti meeting mein gayi.

Govind ke saath nahi — AKELE.

"Main Sunanda Deshpande. Ward 23. Meri gali mein 6 mahine se light band hai. Complaint ki thi. Ek bacchi giri. Haath toota."

"Mera sawaal hai — zimmedaar kaun hai? Aur kab theek hoga?"

Kamre mein silence tha.

Nagar Sevak Kale bola: "Madam, hum dekhenge—"

Sunanda: "Dekhenge nahi. Batao kab hoga. Date do."

Kale: "...Ek hafte mein."

Sunanda: "Likhit mein do."

Kale ne likhit diya.

3 din mein light repair ho gayi.

"Dekhenge" se "3 din" — kyunki ek aurat ne date maanga.

Sunanda pehle: "Kuch nahi hoga."

Sunanda ab:
- Mohalle ki 15 auraton ka WhatsApp group banaya
- Safai schedule track karti hai
- Street light band ho? Same day complaint
- Paani nahi aaya? Photo le ke bhejti hai

"Main 58 saal se yahan rehti hoon. Pehli baar lagta hai ki meri awaaz sunai deti hai."

Yeh transformation ek insaan ki nahi — ek NAGRIK ki hai.

Municipal Corporation mein 50% seats women ke liye reserved hain.

Par ward meetings mein kitni women aati hain? Almost zero.

Sunanda ke baad — 5 aur women aayin.

Jab women civic space mein aati hain — priorities badal jaati hain.

Street lights matter zyada. Safai matter zyada. School matter zyada.

Kyunki yeh UNKI daily reality hai.

Sunanda jaisi har mohalle mein hai.

Woh jo kehti hai — "kuch nahi hoga."
Woh jo sochti hai — "mujhse kya farak padega."
Woh jo JAANTI hai ki problem hai — par chup rehti hai.

Ek meeting.
Ek sawaal.
Ek "date do."

Bas itna chahiye — shuruwat ke liye.

"Bharo. Sab bhar rahe hain."

Se

"Date do. Likhit mein."

Yeh 6 mahine ki journey hai.

Ek aurat ki. Ek nagrik ki.

Sunanda bhi gayi. Tum kab jaoge?

Agle episode mein: Series finale. Tumhari Mahanagarpalika — Govind ki poori journey. Aur tumhare liye ek seedha sawaal.

episodes.title: Tumhari Mahanagarpalika

slides.text:
6 mahine pehle — ek bill aaya tha.

₹11,400.

Govind Deshpande — retired teacher — ne poochha:

"Mera paisa ja kahan raha hai?"

Us ek sawaal ne sab badal diya.

Govind ne kya kiya — 6 mahine mein:

12 RTI file ki
8 formal complaints likhi
5 ward meetings attend ki
1 petition — 214 hastaakshar
Apne nagar sevak se 6 baar mila
Budget objection diya
Tender documents track kiye

Ek RETIRED TEACHER. Akele shuru kiya.

Ab uske saath 30+ log hain.

Kya badla:

✓ 4 street lights repair hui
✓ Property tax correction — ₹1,200 bach gaye
✓ Drainage repair proposal Standing Committee mein
✓ Prashant ka building permission — bina rishwat
✓ Ward meeting mein ab 15-20 log aate hain
✓ Sunanda aur 5 auraton ne civic participation shuru ki

Kya NAHI badla:
✗ Drainage abhi bhi pending
✗ Paani supply wahi hai
✗ Tender system wahi hai

Sach yeh hai:

6 mahine mein sheher nahi badalta.

Par 6 mahine mein NAGRIK badal sakte hain.

Govind badla. Sunanda badli. Prashant badla. Tanvi badli.

Aur jab nagrik badlte hain — system ko badalna PADTA hai.

Dheere. Mushkil se. Par padta hai.

Tumhara Civic Toolkit — 25 episodes mein jo seekha:

1. RTI — ₹10, 30 din, har sawaal ka jawab
2. Written Complaint — likhit, date, acknowledgment
3. Ward Meeting — jao, sawaal poochho, 5 log le jao
4. Petition — 200 hastaakshar = pressure
5. Budget Objection — 8 din ka window, March mein
6. Tender Monitoring — newspaper, RTI, site visit
7. Nagar Sevak — milo, poochho, jawab maango
8. Vote — informed, local, IMPORTANT

Yeh 8 tools tumhare paas hain. Use karo.

Ichalkaranji:

3.5 lakh log.
65 wards.
₹500-800 crore budget.
1,744 government posts.

Agar 3.5 lakh mein se sirf 1% — 3,500 log — active nagrikon ki tarah kaam karein...

Har ward mein 50+ log.

Har meeting mein 50 log.
Har tender pe 50 nazar.
Har election mein 50 informed voters.

Sheher BADAL jayega.

Main Govind Deshpande nahi hoon.

Main ek kahani hoon.

Par TUM real ho.

Tumhara ward real hai.
Tumhara tax real hai.
Tumhari sadak real hai.
Tumhara paani real hai.

Ek sawaal poochho.
Ek RTI file karo.
Ek meeting jao.

Bas EK karo.

Shuruwat ho jayegi.

Tumhara paisa.
Tumhara shaher.
Tumhara sawaal.

Mahanagarpalika TUMHARI hai.

Use karo.

Ya kho do.

— Mahanagarpalika 101
